name: Change Item Price Command Blueprint
description: Blueprint defining the structure for the 'change_price' command.
author: NeoEngine v1

command.name: change_price
command.description: Changes the buy/sell price of an item in the market.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the item.

parameters.name: new_buy_price
parameters.description: The new buy price for the item. If omitted, current price is unchanged.

parameters.name: new_sell_price
parameters.description: The new sell price for the item. If omitted, current price is unchanged.
